title: Final tanθ value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or derive the final numerical answer tanθ = 4/3.

title: Final H value
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state or derive the final numerical answer H = 4d/27.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply kinematic equations for horizontal and vertical motion to relate d, v0, t, and g.

title: Velocity vector decomposition
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly find tanθ from the vertical and horizontal velocity components (gt and v0) at the water entry point.

title: Snell's law application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply Snell's law (n sin α = sin β) to relate the light ray's angles of incidence and refraction at the water surface.

title: Geometric ray diagram
description: Important Criteria: The solution must use geometry (tangents of angles) to relate H, d, and the given heights, connecting the light path to the projectile result.

title: Angle identification
description: Optional Criteria: The solution may explicitly identify the angles (e.g., 37°, 53°) from the Snell's law and geometry steps.

title: Sign or angle confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student confuses the angle θ with its complement or misidentifies the incident/refracted ray angles in Snell's law.

title: Unit or variable misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student treats d as a variable with units incorrectly or omits it in the final expression for H.
